pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Combobox pattern: editable combobox with list autocomplete, without automatic selection.

aria.value: true when the listbox is shown
id of the active option; removed when none
Reflect invalid, required, description and error text

keyboard.action: Opens; activates the selected option or the first enabled option.
Opens; activates the selected option or the last enabled option.
Moves the active option, skipping disabled options, wrapping.
Closes the listbox; keeps the value.
Closes the listbox and moves focus; free text reverts to the selected label.
Edits the text, opens, and filters.

focus: DOM focus always stays on the input; options are never focused. The active option has a visible outline.
notes: Result counts are announced via a polite live region after typing pauses.
The toggle button is excluded from the tab order per the APG example; it has a localized accessible name.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
